text: By deploying more base stations. Why? Because if instead of one, now you create three base stations. That do not interfere with each other, so their coverage, as you can see, does not significantly overlap. Then this base station can use L frequency bands. The important thing clearly is that you design your base station so that their coverage does not overlap, because otherwise they interfere with each other. If you want to further increase your revenues, then you can increase the number of base stations serving your area. So if you are willing to, or the mobile operator is willing to, pay a little bit more in terms of base stations to be deployed, then again, if they do not overlap in terms of coverage with each other, each will be able to serve. A certain number of users that is proportional to the number of frequency bands, L frequency bands. So now, with respect to the previous case, since instead of one base station, we have nine base stations, we have increased the number of subscribers by nine. This is called special reuse.
